product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Round Floating Iron 4 Shelf Wall Unit - 29.72" W, Natural Wood and Silver
product.description: This round unit offers a modern take on shelving with 4 multi-level shelves for displaying a wide array of household items. The rubberwood shelves are held in place by silver-colored iron bars, which also form the circular frame. 29.72"H x 29.72"W x 6.7"D 85% rubberwood; 15% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
